description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in using their GitHub account through the provided GitHub authentication link.
steps: Verify the presence of the GitHub authentication link using its stable selector.
Click on the GitHub authentication link.
Wait for the redirection to GitHub's login page.
On the GitHub login page, enter valid credentials and submit.
Wait for the redirection back to the Roost dashboard page.
Verify that the user is successfully logged in by checking the presence of dashboard elements.
expected_results: User is redirected to the GitHub login page.
User is able to enter credentials and log in.
User is redirected back to Roost and sees the dashboard.
edge_cases: User enters invalid credentials on the GitHub login page.
User cancels the GitHub authentication process.
Network issues during redirection to the dashboard.
User's GitHub account lacks the required permissions.
data_requirements: Roost account linked to a GitHub account.
Access to the GitHub authentication service.
dependencies: User has a valid Roost account linked to GitHub.
api_interactions: Call to GitHub's OAuth2 authentication API.
Roost backend API to validate the authentication token.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the GitHub login page.
Time taken to redirect back to the Roost dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: GitHub authentication link is accessible via screen readers.
Keyboard navigation to the GitHub authentication link is supported.
Color contrast of the GitHub link meets WCAG guidelines.
